known_limitations: The named WP-0146 onboarding packet JSON files were not present in this checkout, so WP-0147 reconciled the authoritative personnel registry from the work package's stated IDs and roles instead of rewriting nonexistent Helen packet artifacts.
No broad fuzzy matching was added; aliases remain deterministic slug/display-title/current-title/explicit-alias based.
merge_authority_or_equivalent: Class A personnel resolver, registry consistency, tests, and reconciliation repair; ready for CA review
pull_request_url_or_not_applicable_reaso: not applicable until PR is created by automation after commit
root_cause: The resolver only resolved canonical employee/mailbox forms, office-prefixed aliases, workers, Alfred queue aliases, and resident-name mappings. It did not perform an unprefixed personnel display-name/current-title alias lookup, so names such as Chief Architect #5, Chief Architect #6, and Chief Character Architect fell through as unresolved unless another resolver path matched. In the checked-out source registry, the Helen-created employee 9-11 records were also absent, while Chief Architect #5 already existed as employee 8; the repair reconciles the registry using the WP-0147/Helen onboarding evidence without creating a duplicate Chief Architect #5.
summary: Added deterministic registry-backed personnel alias resolution for display names, title aliases, hash/no-hash normalized variants, canonical employee.N, and mailbox.N forms; reconciled Helen-created personnel entries for Chief Architect #6, Ingrid, and Chief Character Architect; confirmed Chief Architect #5 resolves to the existing employee 8 record without duplicate creation.
tests_run: PYTHONPATH=src python -m estate.cli.main personnel-resolve --actor "Chief Character Architect" --json
